- There is a black guy at the reception. He is fantastic and such a great asset to the practice, unfortunately the doctor that triage, is at the other end of the spectrum. The man at the reception really did all he could to resolve the issue, but when you have a nonchalant doctor who is uncooperative, all his efforts become useless.

All I wanted was a letter from a GP, that I am registered with, to confirm I am my child's primary carer, all less than 10 lines on an email or letter. Even if it won't be immediately available, you can tell me, at most 2 weeks and not 30days and you only tell me this when I physically come in for an update, not when I made the request.
You won't let me book at an appointment to see a GP. You tell me on the phone to send an email to request and then I keep chasing up the request on the phone, but staff have no access to the email you asked me to send it to and then when I physically come in for an update, then you tell me to go register with patches. So long winded and now I have to look for a better GP to register with, because I don't want to go through a practice that  does not care, especially since they get paid regardless of their bad service.

I even wanted to find out about volunteering here, but lord forbid volunteering at a place where those at  the top, who should be role models and of exemplar conduct are the ones with despicable behaviour. Kudos to the black male receptionist for still remaining so courteous and compassionate even when surrounded by senior members who lack empathy. They can erode these qualities from the man.

Edit:
Racheal, the complaint handler, resolved this issue, so I have changed my review score. The black guy who was so industrious and with bags loads of empathy I believe is called Raymond. When you go in this practice, try and wait in the queue for him because he will treat you with dignity and do all he can to help you.

Edit: 26-1-26
This practice is all about who attends to you. There are a few that are nice and a good number of nonchalant, uncaring staff with nasty attitude and they tend to be the female doctors with Indian,  or Middle East type of look. ( so Pakistan…) The female Chinese doctor is extremely intelligent and compassionate and so is the only black female doctor that I have ever seen there. The Indian type Asian female doctor is horrible and even slags off other doctors in front of the patient. At least she did in front of me. It seems she wants them all to be as horrible and nasty as she is so when she hears another was kind to a patient it irritates her. Funny thing is she is not all knowing.

The one I saw yesterday was arguing with me that an hospital can’t be referred to for certain things even though I know they can cos I have done the procedure there and had the results stipulated the way I asked. She passes on any responsibility to others and makes u wonder what the point is of running a local practice if patient have to directly go to the big hospitals themselves for results.

The most recent doctor I have seen there was horrible, Dr Mariam. I will make sure to avoid her.
On top of that now the facility says they no longer offer same day appointments as they used to. I went in yesterday. Feeling dizzy, with a fever, headache, nausea, feeling faint, she won’t even take basic vitals, only did my blood pressure which was very low. Could not be bothered to take sats, temp or any physical examination just sent me home and told me to drink water. Like am not drinking water already. Extremely unhelpful.
